question: A sum amounts to ₹37044 in 3 years at 5% p.a., interest being compounded yearly. If the same sum amounts to ₹x in 16 months at 12% p.a., when the interest is compounded 8-monthly, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiplying factor for 5% over 3 years is (21/20)³ = 9261/8000.

Principal P = 37044 × (8000 ÷ 9261) = ₹32000.

For 16 months compounded 8-monthly: Rate = 12% × (8 ÷ 12) = 8% per cycle, and Cycles = 16 ÷ 8 = 2.

Amount x = 32000 × (108/100)² = 32000 × 1.1664 = 37324.80.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹37324.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: Amount A₁ = ₹37044, Time = 3 years, Rate = 5% p.a.

Case 2: Time = 16 months, Rate = 12% p.a. compounded 8-monthly.

**Formula Used:**

Amount A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 

 
 P = ?
 
 
 ₹37044
 
 
 Amount x
 
 3 years @ 5% p.a. CI
 2 cycles @ 8%

**Calculations:**

⇒ 37044 = P(1 + 5/100)³

⇒ 37044 = P(21/20)³

⇒ P = 37044 × (8000 / 9261)

⇒ P = 4 × 8000 = ₹32000

For the new 8-monthly compounding scheme:

⇒ Effective Rate r = 12% × (8 / 12) = 8% per cycle

⇒ Number of cycles n = 16 months ÷ 8 months = 2 cycles

⇒ x = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

⇒ x = 32000(1 + 8/100)²

⇒ x = 32000(27/25)²

⇒ x = 32000 × (729 / 625)

⇒ x = 51.2 × 729 = ₹37324.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹37324.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Year Compounding

When compounding happens n-monthly, the applicable rate per cycle becomes R × (n/12), and the number of cycles becomes Total Time (in months) ÷ n.

Compound Interest

CI is evaluated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from preceding periods. The fundamental formula is A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.

SI vs CI Difference

For a 2-year period, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on the same principal is D = P(R/100)².
